page_title: Audio Hijack - Record any audio on Mac

sources.entry: Audio Hijack - Record any application's audio, including VoIP calls from Skype, web streams from Safari, and much more.

summary.name: Audio Hijack
summary.one_liner: Audio Hijack is a Mac app from Rogue Amoeba for recording any audio playing on your Mac, including apps, websites, VoIP calls and system audio.
use_cases: Recording Zoom, FaceTime or other VoIP calls
Saving streaming audio from websites for offline listening
Recording podcasts with mics and mixers
Live streaming audio to YouTube Live, Twitch or Facebook Live
Broadcasting internet radio to Shoutcast or Icecast servers
summary.what_it_does: Audio Hijack records audio from any application on a Mac, from the full system audio mix, or from microphones, mixers and other input devices. Its Application block lets you pick a source such as Safari or FaceTime and hit record. Processing blocks include a Simple Compressor and Magic Boost and Volume blocks for adjusting levels. Outputs include recording, RTMP live streaming to services like YouTube Live, Twitch and Facebook Live, and broadcasting to Shoutcast and Icecast servers. The page also mentions local transcription of recordings and pairing with the Loopback utility to route audio between apps.
notable: Records any app's audio or all system audio at once
Transcription described as done locally with no ongoing charges
caveats: Trial mode applies limitations; the full version requires purchasing a license key
